description: This file defines a CalendarPagerAdapter class that extends FragmentStateAdapter to display Month, Week, and Day fragments within a ViewPager2 component in an Android application.

classes.name: CalendarPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for paging between calendar view fragments (Month, Week, Day).

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of pages, which is 3.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns the appropriate Fragment (MonthFragment, WeekFragment, or DayFragment) based on the position.
